integrity: Explicit proof and standalone finite-field verifier; finite cases do not certify the universal theorem.
scientific_limitations: Finite equicharacteristic local Gorenstein Hilbert function (1,n,1), n>=2, only; classical bilinear-form classification assumed and proved degree counts given. No claim of graph reconstruction outside this family. Publication priority provisional.
title: Degree-sequence rigidity for short finite Gorenstein local algebras
